name: Ego Limiter
body:
Your symbiote is more subservient to you than normal.

Prerequisite: Symbiosis class feature

Benefit(s): Reduce the ego of your symbiote by 1. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, reduce your symbiote’s ego by an additional 1.

Special: A symbiotic slayer can choose to gain this feat in place of their 1st level social talent.
